hypothesis.statement: A complete six-candidate benchmark still cannot support a defensible conform choice unless measurement evidence is normalized, capture failures are rejected, and automated ranking is separated from human identity review.
hypothesis.action: Aggregate the six P25 evidence sets, reject incomplete or non-Go captures, rank canonical-relative face/body measurement error with identity-facing geometry prioritized, and leave selection null until fixed-view human review.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Reviewers receive a deterministic shortlist without mistaking a 2D measurement rank for identity similarity, AAA quality or production readiness.

gates: require both backends and all three unique seeds
require nine valid 1440x2560 Looking Glass Go captures
reject fabricated identity or body similarity scores
exclude candidates above the measurement-error threshold
require human review of front, 45-degree, profile and body views before selection
limitations: 2D landmark error is not an identity score
the rank does not measure topology, skin, eyes, hair, rigging, deformation or AAA quality
any reviewed winner remains a temporary shape estimate for MetaHuman conform

validation.unitTests: 5 shortlist tests and 5 postprocess tests passed

decision: Keep selection null until six real reconstruction candidates pass P25 and a named reviewer completes fixed-view identity review.
